name: Skill Edit Potion
description:
Reallocate 100% of allotted sp and decreases skill and mastery level by one.

**How To Use**
When you use this item, the reallocation window will open. Select the skill you want to edit and click the confirm button.

**Restriction**
None

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
